title: Omni Admin App Settings
description: Operator-configurable settings for Omni Admin. Declare each runtime key here; secret key names are also listed in khal-app.json settings.secrets. Concrete values are set in KHAL OS App Settings — OMNI_API_KEY lives in the KHAL vault and is never committed.

OMNI_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the Omni backend the BFF proxies to (no trailing slash).
